initialExam.title: BEL Trainee Engineer 2026
initialExam.description: BEL recruits Trainee Engineers and Officers for defence electronics manufacturing including radar systems, communication equipment, and electronic warfare systems. 164 vacancies notified.
initialExam.eligibility: B.E./B.Tech in relevant engineering discipline with 60% marks
initialExam.qualifications: B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Mechanical, Computer Science, or related disciplines
initialExam.syllabus: Based on B.E./B.Tech syllabus of respective discipline. Written test covers core engineering subjects.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Test (objective) + Interview. Written test: 120 questions, 120 marks, 2 hours.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Interview → Document Verification → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Trainee Engineer in BEL manufacturing units and R&D centres
initialExam.careerGrowth: Trainee Engineer → Engineer → Senior Engineer → Deputy Manager → Manager → General Manager.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit bel-india.in 2. Download application form 3. Fill and submit offline

salaryRange.description: CDA Pay Scale for BEL Engineers

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Superannuation benefits, Performance incentive

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
